definitions.short: Mattan , the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H4977. Mattan II. מַתָּן proper name, masculine 1. priest of Baal at Jerusalem 2Kin 11:18 2Chr 23:17 ; ᵐ5 Μαγθαν , Ματθαν , ᵐ5 L Ματθαν . 2 father of Shephatiah, in Judah Jer 38:1 ; ᵐ5 Ναθαν , Μαθθα .

occurrences.englishText: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over Yahweh’s house.
All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
